> AeroShield IoT is an off-grid, solar-powered environmental hardware device built with an ESP32-S3 microcontroller, Sensirion SPS30 laser particulate counter, and MPU-6050 anti-tamper motion sensor. When toxic PM10 silica dust exceeds safe thresholds in stone quarries, it autonomously triggers a high-pressure 12V water-mist pump via optocoupled relays to knock down airborne dust within seconds.
